compiled_state.title: provision-ruleset.sh: use jq to extract RULESET_ID from API response instead of grep
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: The RULESET_ID is currently extracted using grep + cut on the raw API response (line 235). This is fragile and can fail with non-trivial JSON or formatting changes. Use jq to parse the response: RULESET_ID=$(echo "$RULESET_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.id')

comments.body: Investigation: provision-ruleset.sh already uses jq -r '.id' at line 248 to extract RULESET_ID. The bug references the fragile grep/cut approach which was fixed in a prior session. Bug no longer applies.
comments.author: Test
